highlights.title: A removed startup job explains its folder
highlights.line: On Windows, removing an agent's startup job says plainly what Start at login will do with its account folder.

highlights.title: A warning before an agent runs twice
highlights.line: Adding an agent that another login job also starts now warns first and names that job.

highlights.title: A typed message survives other text beside it
highlights.line: A message Kosmos was typing to an agent is kept if other text appears beside it, and sent once the box holds only it.

highlights.title: A stalled repeat shows one row
highlights.line: A repeat whose agent cannot be reached shows one row for the stall, not one for every missed run.

highlights.title: Memory rings stay thin and whole
highlights.line: Memory rings keep one thin line as they fill and are never cut off at the edge of their box.
